breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid and a gamma-centered grid. These two settings are mutually exclusive. The ground truth resolves this by removing the 'gamma-centered' instruction. The agent's generated specification incorrectly retained both conflicting instructions, stating: 'Use a Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift and gamma-centered alignment.'
